answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents establish cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs, linking past verifiable work to an immutable stake. Instead of trusting an unproven fable, the network enforces exponential capital exhaustion for each duplicate node in a swarm: initial validation costs a modest falcon token deposit, while scaling a clone army costs superlinear collateral, locking an ivory vault of assets that exhausts malicious swarms.
